title: No navigation (click -> route) test for vacancy-typed notifications; only dropdown-close is asserted
detail: The reviewer briefing requires a navigation test (click -> route) for BOTH entity types, and absence of either is a blocker. The vacancy test explicitly declines to assert the route; no bug-hunt scenario or other test covers vacancy notification click -> /vacancies/<vid> navigation either.
recommended_fix: Add a vacancy-arm pin of the routing decision (e.g. extract the vacancy path builder into a pure helper and test it, or add a bug-hunt scenario asserting URL after notification click).

title: vacancy_detail pb-28 compare-bar padding added but untested; only application_detail padding is pinned
detail: Lens-guard fix 1 requires pb-28 behind the fixed comparison bar on BOTH pages. grep for "pb-28" in client/test finds matches only at client_test.gleam:5022-5043 (the application_detail test); no test exercises vacancy_detail's conditional padding.
recommended_fix: Add a vacancy_detail view test asserting pb-28 present when comparison_ids non-empty and absent when empty, mirroring application_detail_reserves_room_when_comparing_test.

title: Filter pill shrink-0 change (fix 3, chip truncation root-cause) has no test
detail: Fix 3 changed the leaderboard filter pill class so the rail scrolls instead of clipping labels mid-word. No test in client/test references filter pills or their classes (only leaderboard_filter state at line 2221), so a revert of the class would go uncaught.
recommended_fix: Add a leaderboard_view render test asserting the filter pill container/buttons carry shrink-0 (and that no pill truncates), similar to the stepper class pins.

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
detail: A mandated test pin is missing: the vacancy-entity click -> route navigation test (briefing hard-blocker class). Additionally vacancy_detail compare padding and the filter-pill truncation fix are unpinned. Application resolver pins, stepper layout, application_detail padding, and demo touch-target pins all exist and exercise their claims.
recommended_fix: Add the vacancy navigation pin (pure route-builder test or bug-hunt URL assertion), plus vacancy_detail pb-28 and filter-pill class tests; gate rises to PASS once the vacancy navigation contract is exercised.
